label: The mirror image of the actual world satisfies every ESSENCE_5 truth the actual world does
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: orientation-free natures, at w only. For every being x and world-proposition φ, if it lies in the nature of x that φ and φ holds at w, then φ holds at the global mirror image σ w. No nature contains a condition that the actual arrangement meets and its mirror image violates. A nature containing a primitive orientation, or an essential truth about which of two incongruent counterparts is realized, denies it. It says nothing about natures at other worlds.
